title: Concept: Traefik dashboard disclosed
description: The Traefik dashboard is served at this endpoint, so the proxy configuration view with its router and service inventory is reachable.
applicability: Responses served by a Traefik instance with the dashboard enabled.
risk: The dashboard maps every backend address and rule, which is a ready-made target list, and older releases exposed provider data without authentication; MEDIUM because the page is read-only.
